markdownAllowlist._comment: Patterns REPLACE the hook defaults rather than extending them, so the default set is repeated here verbatim before the additions. Bash case-globs: * matches / too, so a trailing /* is recursive. The .claude and .cursor entries exist because the root-architect-execution skill keeps its canonical subagent role definitions and contracts under .claude/skills/root-architect-execution/references/, and the agent wrappers under .claude/agents/ point at them. Without these, every subagent is blocked from reading the role it was spawned to perform.
